column	generations.attempt	smallint NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
column	generations.cancel_requested_at	timestamp with time zone
column	generations.checked_at	timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT clock_timestamp()
column	generations.created_at	timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT clock_timestamp()
column	generations.error	text
column	generations.expires_at	timestamp with time zone
column	generations.id	uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT uuidv7()
column	generations.max_attempts	smallint NOT NULL DEFAULT 1
column	generations.owner_id	uuid NOT NULL
column	generations.payload	json NOT NULL
column	generations.provider	text NOT NULL

column	generations.purpose	text NOT NULL

column	generations.run_at	timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT clock_timestamp()
column	generations.settled_at	timestamp with time zone

comment	schema public	standard public schema
constraint	generation_attempts.generation_attempts_attempt_check	CHECK ((attempt >= 1))
constraint	generation_attempts.generation_attempts_attempt_not_null	NOT NULL attempt
constraint	generation_attempts.generation_attempts_created_at_not_null	NOT NULL created_at
constraint	generation_attempts.generation_attempts_generation_id_fkey	FOREIGN KEY (generation_id) REFERENCES generations(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
constraint	generation_attempts.generation_attempts_generation_id_not_null	NOT NULL generation_id
constraint	generation_attempts.generation_attempts_pkey	PRIMARY KEY (generation_id, attempt)
constraint	generation_attempts.generation_attempts_response_not_null	NOT NULL response
constraint	generations.generations_attempt_check	CHECK ((attempt >= 0))
constraint	generations.generations_attempt_not_null	NOT NULL attempt
constraint	generations.generations_call_matches_status	CHECK (((status <> ALL (ARRAY['pending'::generation_status, 'running'::generation_status])) OR ((status = 'running'::generation_status) = (provider_call_id IS NOT NULL))))
constraint	generations.generations_checked_at_not_null	NOT NULL checked_at
constraint	generations.generations_created_at_not_null	NOT NULL created_at
constraint	generations.generations_error_check	CHECK (((error IS NULL) OR (error <> ''::text)))
constraint	generations.generations_id_not_null	NOT NULL id
constraint	generations.generations_max_attempts_check	CHECK ((max_attempts >= 1))
constraint	generations.generations_max_attempts_not_null	NOT NULL max_attempts
constraint	generations.generations_owner_id_not_null	NOT NULL owner_id
constraint	generations.generations_payload_check	CHECK ((json_typeof(payload) = 'object'::text))
constraint	generations.generations_payload_not_null	NOT NULL payload
constraint	generations.generations_pkey	PRIMARY KEY (id)
constraint	generations.generations_provider_call_id_check	CHECK (((provider_call_id IS NULL) OR (provider_call_id <> ''::text)))
constraint	generations.generations_provider_check	CHECK ((provider <> ''::text))
constraint	generations.generations_provider_not_null	NOT NULL provider
constraint	generations.generations_purpose_check	CHECK ((purpose <> ''::text))
constraint	generations.generations_purpose_not_null	NOT NULL purpose
constraint	generations.generations_request_key_not_null	NOT NULL request_key
constraint	generations.generations_run_at_not_null	NOT NULL run_at
constraint	generations.generations_status_not_null	NOT NULL status
constraint	generations.generations_terminal_fields	CHECK (((status = ANY (ARRAY['succeeded'::generation_status, 'failed'::generation_status, 'cancelled'::generation_status])) = ((settled_at IS NOT NULL) AND (expires_at IS NOT NULL))))
constraint	generations.generations_updated_at_not_null	NOT NULL updated_at
extension	plpgsql	1.0
index	generation_attempts_pkey	CREATE UNIQUE INDEX generation_attempts_pkey ON public.generation_attempts USING btree (generation_id, attempt)
index	generations_check_idx	CREATE INDEX generations_check_idx ON public.generations USING btree (checked_at) WHERE (status = ANY (ARRAY['pending'::generation_status, 'running'::generation_status]))
index	generations_pkey	CREATE UNIQUE INDEX generations_pkey ON public.generations USING btree (id)
index	generations_request_key_idx	CREATE UNIQUE INDEX generations_request_key_idx ON public.generations USING btree (request_key) WHERE (status <> ALL (ARRAY['failed'::generation_status, 'cancelled'::generation_status]))
index	generations_retention_idx	CREATE INDEX generations_retention_idx ON public.generations USING btree (expires_at) WHERE (expires_at IS NOT NULL)
relation	generation_attempts	r
relation	generations	r OPTIONS autovacuum_vacuum_scale_factor=0.02,autovacuum_vacuum_threshold=25,autovacuum_analyze_scale_factor=0.02
schema	public	pg_database_owner=UC/pg_database_owner,=U/pg_database_owner
type	generation_status	e pending,running,succeeded,failed,cancelled
